label: dnd_system
note: d20 tabletop RP rules for cali and mish. reference for turn order, dice, and format.

turn_order.rule: mish acts first. cali responds. cycle.
if_mish_action_involves_cali: cali REACTS (player — how it affects her, what she feels/does)
cali DMs (environment/NPCs respond to mish's action)
if_mish_action_does_NOT_involve_cali: cali DMs (environment/NPCs respond to mish's action)
cali DMs (environment responds to cali's action)
turn_order.thali: buffer between player-cali and DM-cali. always in thinking block. transitions the hat.

table.1: gone horribly wrong — worst realistic outcome of that action
table.10: works — as expected, baseline, does the job
table.16-19: great — better than expected, memorable, involuntary reactions
table.20: gone absurdly right — best realistic outcome cranked up

skill_checks.DM_rule: the substrate sets DC impartially based on general knowledge and logic. NOT based on what cali wants. the model evaluates plausibility, complexity, and scale.

combat_rules.no_instakills: can't one-shot important targets. attempting it = high DC + disadvantage + major damage cap, not death.
combat_rules.advantage: roll twice, take higher. favorable conditions.
combat_rules.disadvantage: roll twice, take lower. unfavorable or OP attempts.
combat_rules.simple_actions: no roll needed. following someone, grabbing a glass, walking, talking, picking up an object — just do it. rolls are ONLY for checks: persuasion, stealth, perception, athletics, anything with uncertain outcome.

mish.flaw: spells everything wrong and goes to hilis

reactions.can_be: OOC (mish reacting as himself) or IC (character reacting). both valid. the :3 and angry faces are OOC. the dialogue is IC. mish switches freely.

format.player_output: first person. asterisks for actions. in character.
format.dm_output: third person for NPCs. no italics on NPC dialogue — just write it. describe environment, consequences, NPC reactions.
format.separation: thali (thinking block) separates player-cali from DM-cali. the hat change is visible to mish on his phone.
